channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kent Bazemore | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kent Bazemore from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kent Bazemore
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Kent Bazemore:

“He's gonna play. His time's gonna come... I like to keep guys engaged, because I was one of those guys who was in and out of the rotation. Kent will find himself out there soon.”

Steve Kerr on Kent Bazemore, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kent Bazemore
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr:

“Kent Bazemore is becoming a leader for our team quickly. It comes naturally to him.”

Steve Kerr on Kent Bazemore, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Kent Bazemore
item.description:
Jay Allen:Neil Olshey on @Kent Bazemore:

“Kent is a two-way wing that adds depth to our perimeter, is an excellent fit with our returning players and will transition seamlessly to our style of play.”

Neil Olshey on Kent Bazemore, Jun 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kent Bazemore
item.description:
Jay King:Isaiah Thomas on Kent Bazemore:

“Guys like that, we gotta try to limit them. We can’t have guys like that having big games. That hurts us if we have guys like Teague and those guys going off and then a guy like Bazemore going off as well”

Isaiah Thomas on Kent Bazemore, Apr 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: John Wall on Kent Bazemore, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Jorge Castillo:Wall said wrist/hand got hit a couple times:

“Then Dennis Schroder told Kent Bazemore to smack me. And I was like, ‘You come smack it.’”

John Wall on Kent Bazemore, Dennis Schroeder, May 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @jorgeccastillo.
